Thanks Vanessa — quick legal/compliance guidance and what we can deliver by 2025-07-30:

1) CAIQ / SIG
- We have a published CAIQ on the compliance portal that answers ~85% of common questions. For the spreadsheet rows that are environment-specific (EU-only processing, dedicated VPC behaviors, KMS/HSM options), Solutions will provide trimmed answers.
- We can provide a completed spreadsheet for MedComm; any sensitive design docs will be redacted.

2) DPIA summary
- We can produce a one-page DPIA executive summary focused on MedComm's pilot (pseudonymized patient metadata + model inference). We'll need a brief data flow diagram and confirmation of which identifiers are present; Rachel pls collect.

3) EU-only processing + contractual wording
- Technical: hosted EU-only is implemented via region lock and data plane restricted to eu-west-1/eu-central-1. For Dedicated/Private we support customer-controlled networking so data does not leave the customer's VPC/region.
- Contractual: we can offer an addendum with an EU-only processing clause and SCCs (EU Standard Contractual Clauses) incorporated. For binding legal language, Legal can provide an addendum draft (NDA optional).

4) VPC, peering, KMS/HSM
- VPC options: private peering (cloud-provider VPC peering), private connector (managed connector), or on-prem package for air-gapped environments.
- KMS: customer-managed KMS keys are supported; HSM-backed KMS (via partner) is supported for enterprise customers — note potential additional lead time and cost.

5) SOC 2 / audit reports
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II attestation under NDA. Latest audit period ended 2024-12-31.

Next steps: Stephanie, please draft the DPIA one-pager and a 2-paragraph technical note on VPC options. Rachel, schedule a 30-min call with MedComm to walk through the DPIA inputs and confirm their timeline. I'll prepare a redacted SOC 2 attestation and coordinate SCC language with Legal.
